text: Ñalnde naafiqiiɓe worɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe rewɓe ɓen wi'anoyta gomɗimɓe ɓen : habbee men, men ndayginora annoora mon on fii lummbugol siraate. Ɓe wi'anee jalkiteede : Yiltoree ɓaawo mon, ɗaɓɓiroyon ton ko ndayginoron. Heedo waɗee hakkunde maɓɓe, hara ko jogiingo damal, tawa nder maggal on no fewtiri gomɗimɓe ɓen yurmeende, ɓaawo on fewtiri naafiqiiɓe ɓen lepte.
